entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Succession disputes and fragmentation into rival principalities: Vladimir-Suzdal, Novgorod Republic, Galicia-Volhynia. The sack of Kyiv (1169) by Andrei Bogolyubsky shifted power northeast. Princes warred while the Mongol threat grew.
